plays.desc_ko: 경기 초반 바텀에서 T1 Peyz(제리)·Keria(유미)가 TLAW 바텀 듀오를 라인에서 밀어내며 이른 시점부터 포션을 소모하게 만듦.
plays.desc_en: Early on, Peyz (Zeri) and Keria (Yuumi) push TLAW's bot duo off the lane, forcing them to burn potions from an early point.
plays.quote: Paysen carrier ... already running them out of the lane ... chug their potions very early.

plays.desc_ko: Jose(녹턴)가 Oner를 상대로 랩터(칼날부리) 캠프를 빼앗거나 나눠 먹으려 싸움을 검. Faker가 미드에서 합류하자 오히려 Jose가 위험해져 점멸로 도주했으나 결국 사망. 리플레이(S0292~S0310)에서 Faker가 먼저 올 수 있는 동선이었는데도 Jose가 랩터에서 강행했다고 재설명.
plays.desc_en: Josedeodo (Nocturne) picks a fight with Oner over the raptor camp, but Faker arrives from mid and Jose, now in danger, flashes away only to die anyway. The replay notes that Faker's pathing allowed him to arrive first, yet Jose forced the raptors regardless.
plays.quote: Jose as well trying to fight ... owner out and split it again. ... Deodo who's in trouble.

plays.desc_ko: 랩터 캠프 싸움에 Faker(애니)가 미드에서 넘어와 기절 스택을 준비한 채 합류. Oner가 2레벨을 먼저 찍어 Q로 Jose를 마무리하고, 추격 과정에서 Quid(갈리오)까지 처치해 라인전 시작 전 2킬. 리플레이에서 Faker의 4스택 점멸-기절-Q 콤보가 재설명됨.
plays.desc_en: Faker (Annie) crosses from mid with his stun stacked to join the raptor fight; Oner (Lee Sin) hits level 2 first, finishes Jose with Sonic Wave, and the chase also takes down Quid (Galio) for two kills before laning even begins. The replay highlights Faker's four-stack Flash-stun-Disintegrate combo.
plays.quote: Faker now wandering over. Camp battle ... Owner wants to keep this fight ... HE'S GOT THE Q AND NOW HE CAN

plays.desc_ko: Faker가 체력 우위로 미니언을 이용해 기절 스택을 쌓으며 미드를 압박하자, CoreJJ가 귀환 후 미드로 내려와 Quid를 위해 웨이브를 밀어줌.
plays.desc_en: As Faker leverages his health lead to stack stuns off minions and pressure mid, CoreJJ (Neeko) comes to mid after recalling to push the wave for Quid.
plays.quote: CoreJJ had to ... on his reset exit out down towards mid. ... CoreJJ is actually just going to finish

plays.desc_ko: 랩터 교전 직후 Oner가 반대편으로 넘어가 TLAW 쪽 랩터 캠프까지 가져감(경기 일시중단 중 회고). 13:39 부근 '모든 것을 가져갔다'는 요약도 이 카운터 정글 흐름과 연결해 중복 처리.
plays.desc_en: Right after the raptor fight, Oner crosses over and takes TLAW's raptor camp as well, a counter-jungle sequence later summed up as T1 'taking everything.'
plays.quote: raptors were stolen away as well in the ... Owner immediately crossed over, took ... raptors, too.

plays.desc_ko: 탑에서 Morgan(자헨)이 W-점멸로 파고들어 Doran(레넥톤)의 점멸을 빼냄.
plays.desc_en: In top lane, Morgan (Zaahen) dives in with a W-Flash and forces out Doran's (Renekton) Flash.
plays.quote: W flash forcing ... the flash out from Doran as well. ... Well played by Morgan.

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 미드 쪽으로 고개를 내밀어 Faker와 함께 미드-정글 2:2 압박. 해설은 점멸이 없는 Jose가 좋은 대응을 하기 어렵다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Oner shows up toward mid to apply 2v2 pressure with Faker, and the casters note a Flashless Jose has few good answers.
plays.quote: as we see Owner ... poking his head into the mid lane ... The mid lane two V two here,

plays.desc_ko: 리셋 후 Jose가 Oner와 돌거북(Krugs) 캠프를 두고 싸우려 접근(블루 버프 우위). Oner가 녹턴의 공격력 강화 시간을 기다린 뒤 캠프를 챙겨 벽을 넘자, 점멸이 없는 Jose와 Morgan은 따라가지 못하고 물러남.
plays.desc_en: After resetting, Jose approaches to fight Oner over the krugs with a blue buff advantage, but Oner waits out Nocturne's empowered window, takes the camp and hops the wall, and the Flashless Jose and Morgan can't follow and back off.
plays.quote: We had a reset from Jose, ... so they're going to fight over these ... Team Liquid just have to walk away. They

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 Jose의 블루 버프 우위와 녹턴 공격력 강화를 기다려 피한 뒤 돌거북을 챙기고 벽을 넘어 빠져나감.
plays.desc_en: Oner waits out Jose's blue buff advantage and Nocturne's empowered attacks, then secures the krugs and slips away over the wall.
plays.quote: Deodo has blue buff advantage. ... wisely waiting out the AD steroid that ... Thorn waiting off to the side, gets the

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 뒤쪽에서 바텀으로 갱킹 진입하고 Peyz가 연계를 노림. Oner가 잠시 CC에 묶였다가 킥으로 CoreJJ를 넘겼지만 CoreJJ는 생존. TLAW가 반격 딜을 넣었고 Q가 적중하며 Peyz가 점멸로 이탈.
plays.desc_en: Oner ganks bot from behind with Peyz looking to follow up; Oner is briefly crowd-controlled, then kicks CoreJJ with Dragon's Rage, but CoreJJ survives. TLAW hits back, landing a Q that forces Peyz to Flash out.
plays.quote: He's in coming from behind. Pays looking ... for the setup. Owner locked down for a ... moment. Gets the kick across. Core is

plays.desc_ko: 바텀에서 앞으로 나온 Peyz를 Yhan(바루스)이 궁극기로 묶고 딜을 넣어 처치. 리플레이: 벽에 붙어 있던 Peyz에게 궁을 맞히고 스택을 터뜨려 킬.
plays.desc_en: Yhan (Varus) roots the overextended Peyz with Chain of Corruption and takes him down; the replay shows Peyz hugging the wall as the ult lands and the Blight stacks are detonated for the kill.
plays.quote: Ulti there from Yhan. ... Lock up there. Good damage, and that's ... GOING TO BE THE KILL. PEYZ overstepping

plays.desc_ko: Peyz가 쓰러진 직후 Keria를 업은 Oner가 들어가 Yhan을 처치. CoreJJ가 반격을 노렸으나 Lee Sin을 잡지 못했고, Oner의 다음 Q가 미니언에 막히도록 웨이브 쪽으로 움직여 생존. 결과는 양 팀 원딜 1:1 교환.
plays.desc_en: Right after Peyz falls, Oner with Keria attached dives in to kill Yhan. CoreJJ looks to retaliate but can't catch Lee Sin, then survives by moving toward the wave so Oner's next Sonic Wave is blocked by minions, ending in a 1-for-1 ADC trade.
plays.quote: His owner manages to go in for a ... little bit more. Owner taking down Yhan. ... back, but I don't think you're killing

plays.desc_ko: T1이 라인을 교체해 Doran을 바텀으로 보내 Yhan 상대 1:1을 맡기고 바텀 듀오는 탑 쪽으로 이동. 22:04 부근 'Peyz가 파밍 공간을 갖도록 빠르게 라인을 재배치' 서술도 같은 운영으로 연결.
plays.desc_en: T1 swaps lanes, sending Doran bot to handle Yhan 1v1 while the bot duo moves top, quickly rearranging lanes to give Peyz room to farm.
plays.quote: swapped over Doran there into the one v ... one versus Yawn ... earlier, when T1 opted to swap their

plays.desc_ko: 바텀 교환 후 T1이 탑으로 시선을 옮겨 4명이 Morgan(자헨)을 다이브하고 Oner도 합류. Morgan은 궁극기(CC 면역)로 버티며 웨이브를 지웠고 체력이 깜빡일 만큼 낮았으나, Oner의 Q가 빗나가고 미드에서 넘어오는 Jose(녹턴) 궁 사정권을 의식해 재다이브가 늦어지면서 점멸을 쓰고 생존.
plays.desc_en: After the bot trade, T1 shifts top and dives Morgan (Zaahen) with four, Oner included. Morgan holds on with his CC-immune ultimate while clearing the wave, and despite flashing low health, he Flashes and survives as Oner's Sonic Wave misses and the threat of Jose's (Nocturne) Paranoia from mid delays the re-dive.
plays.quote: taking that momentum, shifting their ... focus to the top side of the map, ... Here it comes. Four people.

plays.desc_ko: TLAW는 Morgan이 미드 라인을 맡도록 배치를 조정했고 그 사이 Quid가 귀환.
plays.desc_en: TLAW adjusts its setup to put Morgan in mid lane while Quid recalls.
plays.quote: Morgan ... adjusting his lane assignment to pick up ... Squid just now going to be able to get

plays.desc_ko: 궁극기가 없는 Doran이 바텀에 있는 상황에서 CoreJJ(니코)가 시야 안으로 진입해 Doran을 노림. 킬이나 점멸 소모가 이상적이지만 Oner가 근처를 맴돌아 역공 위험이 있었고, TLAW는 무리하지 않고 기존 포탑 압박을 이어감.
plays.desc_en: With Doran bot without his ultimate, CoreJJ (Neeko) steps into vision to target him. A kill or Flash burn would be ideal, but with Oner lurking nearby and counterattack risk, TLAW stays disciplined and keeps up tower pressure.
plays.quote: Nico there, excuse me, and right into ... would be good, but you can see Owner is ... still hovering.

plays.desc_ko: TLAW 바텀 듀오(바루스·니코)가 Doran 상대로 바텀 포탑 방패를 계속 깎고 포탑 체력을 크게 낮춤. Doran은 포탑 아래에서 버팀. 23:26 부근 '첫 포탑 보너스' 회고 언급이 있으나 파괴 시점은 명시되지 않음.
plays.desc_en: TLAW's bot duo (Varus and Neeko) keeps chipping plates off the bot tower against Doran and drops its health significantly while Doran holds under tower.
plays.quote: continuing the work that they started ... chipping away at the plates. ... under tower Doran's is going to try and

plays.desc_ko: T1이 두 번째 드래곤 진행. Oner는 Jose의 견제로 점멸을 뒤로 쓰면서도 오브젝트에 집중했고 Faker는 궁극기 없이 옆에서 대기. 막판 50:50 강타 싸움에서 Oner가 다시 강타로 드래곤 확보.
plays.desc_en: T1 starts the second dragon; Oner stays focused on the objective despite burning Flash backward under Jose's pressure while Faker waits nearby without his ultimate, and Oner wins the final 50/50 Smite to secure it.
plays.quote: staying, keeping his focus on this ... objective. Faker waiting off to the side ... Going to go for the 50/50. Owner once

plays.desc_ko: Jose가 녹턴 궁극기(패러노이아)로 들어가 Oner의 점멸을 빼냈으나 소환사 주문 추적 실수 가능성이 언급됨. 갈리오를 보유한 TLAW가 뒤에서 진입해 강타 범위로 접근하며 스틸을 노렸지만 Yhan 궁극기가 빗나가고 강타 싸움에서도 져 물러남. 해설은 쿨다운은 있었으나 호흡이 맞지 않았다고 평가.
plays.desc_en: Jose dives in with Paranoia and forces out Oner's Flash, though a possible summoner tracking mistake is noted. TLAW pushes in behind with Galio to get into Smite range for a steal, but Yhan's Chain of Corruption misses and they lose the Smite fight, falling back; casters say the cooldowns were there but the timing was off.
plays.quote: Jose looking for the play, gets the ... Might have mis tracked the summoner. ... that is the paranoia down.

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 시야 장악을 유지해 라인 안전을 확보. 23:05 부근 회고에서도 T1이 TLAW 정글 쪽에 추가 와드를 깔아 연속 플레이를 했다고 서술.
plays.desc_en: Oner maintains vision control to keep the lanes safe, with T1 also placing extra wards in TLAW's jungle to chain plays together.
plays.quote: Meanwhile, owner doing a very good job ... in keeping the vision control here to ... look at all the extra vision here laid

plays.desc_ko: 바텀 쪽에서 CoreJJ가 T1 진입으로 위기에 몰림. 'Yone'(문맥상 Yhan 추정)이 벽을 넘어 합류하자 Oner가 킥으로 밀어냄. 스킬 교환과 Jose 궁극기(패러노이아) 사용이 있었고 Oner 킥으로 이탈이 이루어짐. 해설은 이후 T1의 '침투'에 TLAW가 답이 없었다고 정리.
plays.desc_en: CoreJJ is caught in trouble on the bot side by T1's engage; when Yhan hops the wall to help, Oner kicks him away with Dragon's Rage. After an exchange of skills and Jose's Paranoia, Oner's kick enables the disengage, and the casters conclude TLAW had no answer to T1's incursion.
plays.quote: Escor de J ... is in trouble. Yone coming over the ... wall. Kickback from owner is there.

plays.desc_ko: 같은 시점 탑 쪽에서 TLAW가 Faker를 노린 플레이. Jose는 따라갈지 고민했고, Faker가 강가 쪽으로 점멸을 쓰며 탈출하자 TLAW는 끝까지 들어가지 않음.
plays.desc_en: At the same time up top, TLAW goes after Faker; Jose hesitates to follow, and when Faker Flashes toward the river to escape, TLAW doesn't commit fully.
plays.quote: Another play on the top side. ... Jose Deodo debating if he can follow. ... manages to escape on the top side play

plays.desc_ko: TLAW가 바텀으로 TP를 활용해 Doran을 노린 다이브. Morgan이 보호막을 두르고 돌진했고 Doran은 궁극기로 버팀(Quid에게 기절이 들어가고 도발도 사용됨). 결국 Doran 생존.
plays.desc_en: TLAW uses Teleport for a bot dive on Doran; Morgan charges in shielded, but Doran holds on with Dominus while Quid is stunned and a taunt is used, and Doran survives.
plays.quote: It's a TP to the bottom lane. ... TL determined to make a play onto Doran. ... Morgan dashing in has that extra shield.

plays.desc_ko: TLAW의 두 플레이가 진행되는 동안 Faker는 탑 사이드 라인을 밀어 포탑까지 진출.
plays.desc_en: While TLAW's two plays unfold, Faker shoves the top side lane all the way to the tower.
plays.quote: to finish off either play and Faker had ... been pushing up to the side lane on top ... side so he got all the way to the tower

plays.desc_ko: 같은 시각 미드에서도 TLAW가 플레이 시도. Peyz는 잠시 더 버텼고, 'Osito'(문맥상 Jose 추정)가 Oner를 끝까지 쫓았으나 마무리하지 못함. 회고: Peyz는 점멸·정화, Keria는 소환사 주문 두 개를 모두 소모.
plays.desc_en: TLAW also makes a play in mid at the same time; Peyz holds out a bit longer, and Jose chases Oner all the way but can't finish him. In hindsight, Peyz used Flash and Cleanse while Keria burned both summoner spells.
plays.quote: trying to make another play at the same ... Pays living for an extra second ... Osito continuing to walk up hoping

plays.desc_ko: TLAW가 드래곤 주변에 전원 집결한 사이 T1이 스플릿 푸시로 포탑 하나를 추가로 파괴.
plays.desc_en: With TLAW fully grouped around dragon, T1 split pushes to take down another tower.
plays.quote: Another tower here goes down to the T1 ... split push as TL are fully grouped up

plays.desc_ko: T1이 협곡의 전령을 미드 라인으로 풀어 돌진시키며 TLAW의 대응을 강요.
plays.desc_en: T1 releases the Rift Herald into mid lane, forcing TLAW to respond.
plays.quote: Yeah, Harold ... Harold going into the mid lane. They're ... just going to let it charge.

plays.desc_ko: TLAW가 드래곤 주변에 집결한 상황에서 T1이 세 번째 드래곤(소울 포인트)을 진행. TLAW 합류가 늦은 가운데 Jose가 둥지 중앙으로 들어왔으나 50:50 강타는 다시 Oner가 성공.
plays.desc_en: With TLAW grouped near dragon, T1 takes the third dragon for soul point; TLAW is late to arrive and Jose enters the pit, but Oner wins the 50/50 Smite again.
plays.quote: Who's going to get the 50/50? ... Jose Deodo ready to get into the mid of ... the pit, but once again, it is Owner.

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤을 잃는 와중 CoreJJ가 점멸로 진입해 3명을 묶음. Faker는 묶였다가 점멸로 빠지고 Keria가 살리려 했으나 Morgan이 Faker를 마무리. 리플레이: 니코-갈리오 연계, Jose가 Faker 쪽으로 전력 진입. 이후 TLAW가 다시 합류해 Quid가 더블킬(Peyz·Keria로 추정). 해설은 'TL이 드래곤은 잃었지만 교전은 가져갔다'고 정리.
plays.desc_en: As the dragon falls, CoreJJ Flashes in to catch three with Pop Blossom; Faker Flashes out but Keria's save falls short and Morgan finishes him. The replay shows the Neeko-Galio combo and Jose's full commit onto Faker, and as TLAW regroups Quid gets a double kill, likely on Peyz and Keria; casters sum it up as TL losing the dragon but winning the fight.
plays.quote: Flash forward from Core. Manages to find ... three. Immediate lock up onto Faker, but ... but Morgan WILL GET THE JOB DONE.

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 강타 후 추격하고, 너무 앞에 나온 'Yone'(Yhan 추정)을 상대로 소환사 주문이 없던 Peyz·Keria가 도망 대신 맞서 싸워 Peyz가 1킬. 그러나 TLAW 후속 합류로 Peyz·Keria가 잡힘.
plays.desc_en: Oner chases after Smiting, and Peyz and Keria, without summoners, fight the overextended Yhan instead of fleeing, with Peyz getting a kill, but TLAW's follow-up catches both of them.
plays.quote: Now top the smite. He's going to chase. ... YONE IS TOO LOW. THIS IS A DISASTER. ... PEYZ IS GETTING A KILL.

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 바텀 쪽에 있는 가운데 T1이 시야를 걷어냈지만, Morgan은 녹턴 지원을 믿고 버티며 파밍을 계속.
plays.desc_en: With Oner on the bot side, T1 clears vision, but Morgan stays and keeps farming, trusting Nocturne's support.
plays.quote: Let's see if Morgan is under attack ... Owner on the bottom side of the ... to farm as even though T1 clear out the

plays.desc_ko: Oner가 TLAW의 움직임을 포착해 노출시켰고, TLAW는 전력 진입을 하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Oner spots and exposes TLAW's movement, and TLAW holds off on a full engage.
plays.quote: Oner spotted out the TL. They don't want ... to full send here.

plays.desc_ko: 소울 드래곤 앞 교전 개시: Faker가 묶으려 진입해 기절은 맞혔지만 서로 점멸을 주고받는 교환.
plays.desc_en: The fight in front of soul dragon begins as Faker goes in to lock someone down, landing a stun in a Flash-for-Flash exchange.
plays.quote: from Faker looking to lock ... the stun still does connect. ... But it's a flash for flash trade.

plays.desc_ko: Quid(갈리오)의 측면 진입은 Oner에게 포착됐지만, 이어진 궁극기로 Faker를 묶어 스펠실드에도 불구하고 Faker를 처치('Yone'=Yhan 추정이 마무리).
plays.desc_en: Quid's (Galio) flank is spotted by Oner, but his follow-up Hero's Entrance locks down Faker and kills him through his spell shield, with Yhan finishing.
plays.quote: And Quid was scouted on his attempt on ... the flank here by Owner. ... in looking to lock down Faker, stop him

plays.desc_ko: Faker가 쓰러진 뒤 Doran이 교전 뒤쪽에서 싸우고 Peyz가 합류해 연속 킬. Quid는 위치가 어긋났고, 도망칠 곳이 없던 'Yone'(Yhan 추정)도 버티지 못하며 Keria를 업은 Peyz가 트리플킬.
plays.desc_en: After Faker falls, Doran fights at the back of the brawl and Peyz joins for consecutive kills; Quid is out of position and Yhan has nowhere to run as Peyz, with Keria attached, earns a triple kill.
plays.quote: side is Doran in the midst of the fight. ... Pays is here as is Doran. ... Another kill going over to Pays.

plays.desc_ko: 트리플킬 후 T1이 소울 드래곤을 진행. 양 팀 모두 강타가 없는 상태에서 TP 합류와 정글러 합류 경쟁이 이어졌고, Oner는 TLAW 와드에 접근이 노출된 상태에서도 제어 와드 너머로 강타를 성공시켜 소울 확보. 'bear'(애니의 티버로 추정)가 TLAW 진영에서 활약했고 TLAW는 후퇴.
plays.desc_en: After the triple kill, T1 starts soul dragon as both sides race with Teleports and jungler arrivals without Smite ready; despite his approach being spotted by TLAW wards, Oner lands Smite over the control ward to secure the soul while Annie's Tibbers wreaks havoc in TLAW's ranks and TLAW retreats.
plays.quote: dragon soul. ... There's no smite for either team. ... OH, but the TPs.

plays.desc_ko: 소울 저지를 위해 Morgan이 돌진, 궁극기 CC로 Peyz를 묶어 드래곤을 지키려 함(리플레이: CoreJJ의 콤보 진입이 Morgan의 거리 좁히기를 도움). 이어 Carry(Keria 추정)를 CC로 묶었으나 Quid가 위기에 몰렸고, TLAW는 일부 킬을 얻었지만 후퇴했으며 소울은 T1이 가져감.
plays.desc_en: Morgan charges in to deny the soul, locking Peyz with his ultimate CC, helped by CoreJJ's combo engage closing the distance. He then catches Keria, but Quid falls into danger, and TLAW takes some kills before retreating as T1 claims the soul.
plays.quote: Morgan hoping to get something. ... Morgan dashing IN. ULTI LOCKS UP PAYS ... MORGAN HOLDING THE LINE WILL NOT

plays.desc_ko: CoreJJ(니코)가 랩터로 위장한 '미스터리 랩터' 상태로 잠복. 미니맵에는 보이지 않았지만 와드에 노출되었고 T1 쪽('Towers', 선수 불명)이 이를 찾아냄. 이후 원래 모습으로 돌아옴.
plays.desc_en: CoreJJ (Neeko) lurks disguised as a 'mystery raptor'; invisible on the minimap but revealed by a ward, he is found by T1 and returns to his normal form.
plays.quote: mystery raptor ... have a ward by it. ... Looking for that chicken. Towers sniffs

plays.desc_ko: T1이 바론을 시작해 TLAW에게 싸움 또는 오브젝트 포기를 강요. Oner는 싸움을 열지 고민했고, 궁극기 사용과 함께 '후퇴'가 선택됨.
plays.desc_en: T1 starts Baron to force TLAW into a fight or concede the objective; Oner weighs opening a fight, and with ultimates used, a retreat is chosen.
plays.quote: T1 in classic T1 fashion just going to ... start the Baron, kind of force Team ... Owner holding on debating do

plays.desc_ko: TLAW가 Jose 녹턴 궁극기로 후방에서 진입했고 Yhan(바루스) 궁극기는 강가 쪽으로 빗나감. 궁극기를 모두 쓴 뒤 T1의 역습에 전멸.
plays.desc_en: TLAW engages from behind with Jose's Paranoia while Yhan's (Varus) Chain of Corruption misses toward the river; with all ultimates spent, they are wiped by T1's counterattack.
plays.quote: Ulti in the backside from ... Jose Deodo. ... confident turn to deny Jose's engage.

plays.desc_ko: Peyz가 벽을 넘어와 반격을 시작하고 빠른 이동속도로 Jose를 쫓음. Oner가 킥-점멸로 TLAW 진영을 가로지르고 'Yone'(Yhan 추정)이 즉시 처치되며 Peyz가 쿼드라킬, T1이 TLAW를 전멸시킴.
plays.desc_en: Peyz hops the wall to start the counterattack and chases Jose down with high movement speed; Oner kicks and Flashes across TLAW's formation, Yhan is deleted instantly, and Peyz secures a quadra kill as T1 aces TLAW.
plays.quote: Pays coming over the ... WANTS TO TURN IT NOW AND HE IS ... HE'S JUST RUNNING JOSE

plays.desc_ko: 전멸 후 T1이 미드로 밀고 내려가 경기를 마무리. Peyz가 추가 킬을 노리며 깊이 들어갔고 TLAW가 마침내 Peyz를 처치했지만 너무 늦었고, T1이 승리해 시리즈 3:0으로 MSI 첫 시리즈를 가져감.
plays.desc_en: After the ace, T1 pushes down mid to end it; Peyz dives deep for more kills and TLAW finally takes him down, but too late as T1 wins to sweep the series 3-0 and claim its first MSI series.
plays.quote: T1 barreling down the mid lane looking ... to make it a clean sweep versus TL. ... He's not done. He wants a few
